Hi Mark,

If your counts are binomial, then no, we haven't implemented that model yet. If you have multinomial data (e.g. removal, capture-recapture or distance data) then you could use gmultmix() or gdistsamp().

Richard

Does the R package 'unmarked' include a model for estimating mean super-population size and temporary emigration (or availability for detection) using a binomial N-mixture model?  I could not locate mention of such a model in the package documentation or in the archives of this Google group.  However, I might have missed it.  Thank you in advance for any help with this question.
